chapters.title: Once there was a fast car…
p: Once there was a fast car named Bob. Bob was very special because he could zoom. One day Bob was feeling extra energetic, so he asked his friend Dog to come for a ride with him.
Dog was so excited "Yay, can we really zoom?!" he shouted.
Bob smiled. "Yes we can, but only if you wear your seatbelt". Dog laughed and quickly grabbed his seatbelt and put it on.
Bob revved his engine and off they zoomed down the street. They had so much fun driving around. The wind blew back their hair, and dogs fur fluttered.
Eventually Bob needed to slow down. He looked over at Dog and saw him holding on tightly to the seatbelt. Dog's face was serious, but his eyes were wide with excitement.
Bob was glad his friend was having fun. He decided that they should take some tape and mark the spot they stopped. So they did, and they zoomed off home afterwards.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. She liked to act silly and have fun. She had a special box she kept in her room that was full of little herbs. Whenever Mia was feeling sad, she knew the herbs could help.

One day, Mia's mom noticed that Mia was feeling particularly emotional. Her mom took Mia to to the kitchen and set out a special herb in front of her. Mia knew this was a special herb because it looked very fragile.
Mia's mom said, “Now Mia, if you eat this herb, it will make you feel better.”
Mia looked at her mom, and said, “OK. I will try.”
Mia closed her eyes, and courageously ate the delicious herb.
Soon enough, Mia felt a calmness come over her. She opened her eyes and smiled at her mom.
Mia said, “It was so yummy, Mommy! I feel a lot better now.”
Mia's mom smiled, and said, “I'm happy it worked, my sweet girl.”

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a brave girl named Sammy. One day, she went for a walk in the woods. As she walked, she saw something very interesting. It was a big, shiny statue! Sammy had never seen something like this before. She reached out to touch it. Suddenly, the statue began to tremble!
Sammy was so scared, she started to shake. She yelled out in surprise, "What! What's happening?" When no answer came, she slowly backed away.

Just then, a friendly voice said, "Don't worry little one, I'm here to help." Sammy looked up and saw a giant standing before her. He smiled and said, "My name is Tony. I'm here to protect this special statue."
He reached out his giant hand and touched the statue. The trembling stopped. Sammy smiled and said, "Your statue is very interesting. Can I touch it?"
Tony nodded, "Yes, but be careful. The statue is very old, and needs to be handled with care."

So Sammy carefully touched the statue and discovered something that amazed her. It felt like a part of her! From that day on, Sammy and Tony became very good friends. They spent many afternoons exploring the woods, watching the statue tremble in the wind and having lots of fun.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little boy called Billy. He was very excited to go to the beach. He asked his parents if he could go, and they said yes.
When they got there, Billy was so happy. He grabbed his bucket and ran to the edge of the sea. He loved watching the waves as they dived back into the sea.
Billy had his bucket full of sand and shells. He said to his parents, "Can I dive into the wave now?". His parents said, "Yes, if you're careful!".

Billy was so excited about diving into the wave. He took a deep breath, and then he dived. He felt the cold water splash against his skin and he stayed underwater for a few seconds until the wave had died down.
When he resurfaced, his parents were so proud of him and told him he did really well. Billy was so happy and said, "I want to do it again!".
Billy kept diving into the waves for hours, until he started to feel very tired. Eventually, his parents told him it was time to go home.
Billy loved his day at the beach and couldn't wait to go back. He said goodbye to the waves, and then he said goodbye to the beach.
As they drove home, Billy fell asleep after a long, tiring and fun day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a youth named Tom. Tom was a happy kid, but he sometimes felt lonely. One day he stumbled across a small green door in the woods.
Tom opened the door and found himself in a vast and magical land. He was amazed at all the different colors, animals and people.
Tom said hello to everyone he saw and soon he was introduced to a group of cheerful youths. They welcomed him with open arms and invited him to join them in their adventures.
Tom was very excited. He asked, “What do you do?”
One of the youths replied, “We have to endure some harsh tasks, but the rewards are worth it!”
Tom couldn’t believe his ears. He was eager to join them on their journey.
So, Tom and the group of youths went on their adventure and experienced many exciting and challenging things. He grew stronger and wiser, and made many friends along the way.
Tom never forgot his experience in the magical land and how he was introduced to the wonderful youths. From then on, he proudly called the youths his best friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a family. They weren’t rich, but they didn’t have much money. So they weren’t very happy.
One day the father looked out the window. He noticed a poor family living on the street. The father felt so sad for them.
He called his family over to look. “See that view?” he said. “We must care for them.”
The mother turned to the kids, “Let’s bring them some food and share what we have.”
The kids smiled. “Yeah, let’s do it!”
So the family loaded up a cart of food and blankets, and they went to the poor family.
The poor family was so grateful and thanked the family a lot.
The father said, “Always care for those who need it.”
The kids smiled with agreement and the family went back home.
The End.

chapters.title: Once there was a sweet little…
p: Once there was a sweet little girl called Millie. She was very happy and had wonderful knees. Every day she loved to play in her garden and watch the trees begin to grow.
One day Millie was playing with her toys in the garden. Suddenly, she heard a noise! When she looked up, she saw a tiny tree sapling right in front of her.
She was very surprised and excited. She kneeled down, picked up the sapling and examined it carefully. Then she smiled and said "It's a perfect fit for this garden".
Millie dug the hole with her hands and planted the sapling. From that day on, she watered the sapling every day to help it grow. Millie was very proud of her new tree and loved to watch it grow.

Every day, Millie would kneel down beside the tree and tell it how much she loved it. And sure enough, the tiny sapling began to grow and soon Millie had a tall and beautiful tree in her garden. She was so proud of it and loved it more than anything.
The End!

chapters.title: Tim was a very nosy threeyearold…
p: Tim was a very nosy three-year-old who loved exploring. He was always looking for things to do, and he especially liked playing in the hall.

One day he decided to try something new - he wanted to succeed at climbing the stairs. He reached the first stair and climbed up with a big smile on his face. He was almost to the top when he heard a voice behind him.
"What are you doing, Tim?" It was his mom.
Tim looked back and said, "I'm trying to succeed at climbing the stairs."
His mom smiled and said, "That's wonderful! I'm so proud of you, keep going!"
With her encouragement, Tim made it to the top. He was so proud and he couldn't wait to tell his friends. After that day, Tim never stopped succeeding in everything he tried.

chapters.title: There were two friends Tom and…
p: There were two friends, Tom and Jack. Tom looked out the window and saw the yellow sun setting in the sky.
Tom said to Jack, "Let's go play in the park!"
Jack jumped up with joy and they got ready to go. They planned to be at the park in one minute.
They put on their yellow hats and gloves, grabbed their bags and ran out the door.
They laughed as they raced down the street, sprinting as fast as they could to get to the park.
They reached the park in one minute exactly! They were so proud of themselves for planning that well.
Tom and Jack ran around, played tag, and laughed until the sun set. Then it was time to go home.
They hugged goodbye and Tom said, "Let's plan to meet here tomorrow!"
Jack nodded and smiled. What a fun day they had.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jane. One day, she started to wonder what was under her bed. She tip-toed over to the bed and peaked underneath. Suddenly, she saw something long and scary!
Jane jumped back and shouted, "It's a monster!" Jane was so scared that she ran to the other side of the room and hid behind the chair.

The monster crept out from under the bed. He was very gentle and said, "Don't be scared. I'm just looking for my lost ball." Jane looked at the monster and asked, "Where did you lose your ball?" The monster replied, "I'm not sure. I think it might have rolled under your bed."
So, Jane and the monster searched under the bed together. Soon, they found the ball and the monster said, "Thank you for helping me find my ball."
As Jane watched the monster's big tail wiggle away, she began to wonder what else was under her bed.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She was three years old and she loved to play.
One day, the girl was in the park with her dad. He was holding a rod in his hand. Suddenly, the girl saw a delicious-looking apple on the ground. She pointed at it and demanded it from her dad.
"Can I have it, Daddy?" she asked.
Her dad smiled and gave her the apple. He said, "Yes, sweetheart. Just don't eat it all at once!"
The little girl took a bite of the apple and smiled. It was so delicious! She thanked her dad and they shared the yummy treat.
The girl and her dad finished the apple and went back home. They had a lovely time in the park.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old, and she loved to visit the store with her mom and dad.
One day, Lucy went to the store with her mom.
When they got there, Lucy saw something really weird. It made her cry.
Her mom said, “What is it, Lucy? Why are you crying?”
“It’s so weird!” said Lucy.
“What is it?” said her mom.
“It’s a purple monster! Right there!” said Lucy, pointing at a strange object.
“That’s not a monster,” said her mom, “It’s just a toy. You don’t have to cry.”
Lucy stopped crying and smiled. She was so happy that it wasn’t a monster. She thanked her mom and ran off to explore the store.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a girl called Julia. Julia had a special dress that she liked to wear every day.
The dress was very thick and it kept her warm. One day, Julia decided to go out and wear her dress. She put it on and straightened it out.
Julia looked in the mirror and smiled. It was perfect. She decided to go to the park to play.
As Julia was playing at the park, she bumped into her friend Anna.
"Julia, why are you wearing such a thick dress?" Asked Anna.
Julia smiled and replied, "I'm wearing this dress because I want to look complete! And this dress is perfect for me."
Anna smiled and agreed. Then the two friends hugged and went to play more games. They had a lot of fun together and Julia never ever forgot to wear her special dress.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a silly pony. He loved to eat cream every day. One morning the pony was walking to the meadow, when he spotted something funny. It was a rabbit wearing a hat! The pony thought it was very silly and funny. The bunny said, “What’s so funny?” The pony laughed and said, “I think it’s foolish that you are wearing a hat!”
The rabbit replied, “I’m wearing a hat to be cool!” The pony looked puzzled and asked, “How does a hat make you cool?” The rabbit smiled and said,

“When I wear this hat, everyone recognizes me!” The pony thought that was really neat, so he put on a hat too. From then on, the pony was well known throughout the meadow and everyone recognized him too. He was no longer a silly pony, but the most famous pony in the world!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sally. Sally was three years old and loved to hop around. She liked hopping all around the house, in the garden and on the streets.
One day, Sally went to get a haircut. She was very excited to get a new look, but also a little bit frightened. She hopped over to the hairdresser’s chair and sat down.
The hairdresser said, “Just close your eyes and relax. I promise you’ll look lovely when I’m done!” But Sally was too frightened and she opened her eyes.
The hairdresser said, “Don’t be frightened, dear Sally. You are going to be the most beautiful girl when I finish the haircut.” Then Sally relaxed and closed her eyes.
When the hairstyle was finished, Sally felt like a princess. She looked in the mirror and smiled. Now everyone was impressed with her new look!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a great little girl named Janey. One night, Janey was very excited because it was foggy outside. She looked out the window in awe of the fog and said to her mom, "Mom, can I go outside? I want to give the fog a hug!"
Her mom smiled and said, "No Janey, it's too foggy. How about I give you a big hug instead?" Janey smiled and said, "Yes, that's great!"
So Janey and her mom hugged each other tightly and shared the LOVE! <3

chapters.title: One day Peter and his mom…
p: One day, Peter and his mom went to the park. Peter's mom told Peter he needed to use his muscles. She wanted him to help carry a heavy box. Peter asked why he needed to carry it. His mom told him it would serve them both.
So they each grabbed an end of the box and started carrying it. It was so heavy that it was hard for them to walk. "We can do it!" said Peter's mom.
Peter tried his hardest, but he was tired after a few steps. He asked his mom if it was ok to take a break.
His mom said it was ok and put the box down. Then she lifted Peter up and showed him a big playground! She told him that their job of carrying the heavy box was done, so now it was time to have fun.
Peter was so happy that they had served each other well, and he couldn't wait to have fun at the playground.

chapters.title: Mummy was sitting in the living…
p: Mummy was sitting in the living room, playing with Timmy. The sun was shining bright outside, and the birds were singing.
"Time to get ready, Timmy," said Mummy. "I'm taking you to nursery school."
"Yay!" said Timmy, jumping up and down. He grabbed his school bag and they both went out the door.
At nursery school, Timmy looked around. All the other children were there, and they were having fun. Mummy said goodbye and promised to come pick him up.
The teacher said, "Hello, Timmy. My name is Miss Smith. Would you like to play?"
Timmy smiled and nodded his head. He liked Miss Smith's name very much.
The children played fun games. Some of the games helped them improve their counting skills. Others games made them sleepy.
At the end of the day, Timmy was a bit tired but he was happy too. He had improved his counting and he had met a nice teacher.
Mummy appeared and said, "How was it today, Timmy?"
Timmy smiled. "It was great, Mummy. I had fun and I improved my counting."
Mummy smiled and said, "That's wonderful! Let's go home and get some rest."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a little girl called Jacky. She was three years old and very bossy. She liked to do things by herself and never listened to anyone.

One sunny day, Jacky went to the park and saw a chain that someone had left on the ground. She liked the shiny links and wanted to play with it. She stood up and grabbed the chain with her little hands. Then she began to drag it around the park.
Suddenly, a boy appeared and said, "Hey! That's not yours!"
Jacky stared at the boy and said, "It's mine, I'm bossy!"
The boy shook his head and said, "No it's not. You need to put it back where you found it."
Jacky didn't want to listen, so she kept on dragging the chain around. The boy decided to take Jacky back to the chain and make her stand there until she agreed to put it back.

At first, Jacky was angry but soon she realized that the chain didn't belong to her and she had to give it back. She put the chain back on the ground, said sorry to the boy and promised to never again take someone else's things.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a nosy cat called Tom. One day Tom was very bored so he decided to go for a swim. He hopped into a big blue pool and started paddling around.

As Tom was swimming around the pool, he saw something special at the bottom. It was a big, colourful cushion! Tom was very excited but he couldn't reach the cushion from the water so he decided to ask for help.

Tom shouted to the other animals in the garden “Can you help me get my cushion?” The rabbits and the birds just looked at him but then a friendly frog said “Hop onto my back and I will take you to the cushion”.
So Tom hopped onto the frog’s back and the frog took him right to the bottom of the pool. Tom grabbed the cushion and both Tom and the frog swam back up to the top.
Tom was very happy as he hugged his big cushion and said “Thank you so much for your help. I will never be bored again!”

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and wanted to go to the ocean. So, one sunny day, she and her mom packed their bags and went to the beach.
When they arrived, Lucy was so excited. She saw the big, green ocean and wanted to catch something. She grabbed her bucket and ran to the waves.
Lucy said, "Mom, I'm going to catch something."
Her mom replied, "Okay, sweetie. Just be careful."
With that, Lucy grabbed her net and started to catch things. She caught some seashells and some sand dollars. Lucy even caught a few small fish. Then she put them all in her bucket.
At the end of the day, Lucy brought her bucket of ocean treasures with her back home. She was so happy that she had caught so many things from the big, green ocean.

chapters.title: One day a girl named Lucy…
p: One day, a girl named Lucy was playing outside in her backyard. She saw a thin spin on the ground. She bent down to pick it up.
"Hi, little spin!" Lucy said.
The spin said "Hi!" to her.
"Do you want to play with me in my station?" Lucy asked. Thespin was so excited that it started to jump up and down.
The spin and Lucy went to the station. They started spinning around and around until they were so dizzy.
"That was so much fun!" Lucy said, laughing.
The spin smiled and nodded its head. They had a great time together.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a mommy who made a soup. It was dark and yummy.
"Mommy, what kind of soup is it?" asked the little boy.
"It is tomato soup," said the mommy.
The little boy was excited and he wanted to share it.
"Let's spread it around the house so everyone can have some," the little boy said.
So the little boy and his mommy spread the soup around the house for everyone to enjoy. Everywhere the soup went, everyone was happy and smiling.
"This soup is so delicious! Thank you for sharing it, Mommy," said the little boy.
The mommy smiled and said, "You're welcome, my little one. I'm so glad you wanted to spread it around the house."
The end.

chapters.title: Once there was an ordinary carpet…
p: Once there was an ordinary carpet in a room. A little girl named Lilly wanted to pass over the carpet. She asked her mom, "Mom, can I pass?"
Her mom said, "Yes, but be careful not to trip. So make sure you walk slowly and look at the carpet."
Lilly nodded and carefully stepped onto the carpet. She shuffled slowly across the carpet and was very proud of herself.
When she reached the other side, she stopped and said, "I did it! I passed!"
Her mom smiled and said, "Good job, sweetie!"
Then Lilly ran around the room and passed back and forth over the carpet many times. Soon, she was tired and went to sit down with her mom.
"I'm so happy that I could pass over the carpet," said Lilly.
Her mom replied, "So am I, my love. You did a wonderful job."

chapters.title: One day Lily was walking with…
p: One day, Lily was walking with her mom when they came across a gloomy store. They stepped inside and Lily saw something special. A beautiful pair of sunglasses.
"Mom," Lily said, with excitement, "I want those sunglasses!"
"They look lovely," said her mom, "but we need to keep looking. We are here to get milk, remember?"
But Lily had already forgotten and she grabbed them off the shelf.
"OK," said her mom, "but you need to remember to look after them. You need to be careful not to forget them anywhere."
Lily promised she would not forget them. She put them on her face and smiled.
From then on, everywhere Lily went, she would wear her new sunglasses. They made her so happy!
